memo: Helped: only the batch change in slot 0 (TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2^17, MATRIX_LR 0.032), scoring 1.0516/1.0528, incumbent mean 1.0522. It carries a tripwire flag, so audit it before building on it. Did not help: 2^18 batch (1.0918), grad clipping (1.0525), shorter warmdown (1.0558), cosine decay (1.0559), EMA (1.2496), and all architecture changes (1.0584 to 1.0619; 1.0526 for DEPTH 6 with ASPECT_RATIO 96). Slot 15 (label smoothing) was invalid with a target_leak flag, so avoid loss changes that touch targets. Near misses, all about 0.002 better and possibly noise: WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 (1.0501), embedding/unembedding LR 0.3/0.008 (1.0500), warmdown 0.7 (1.0502). The combined WD 0.1 plus LR change scored 1.0506, so gains didn't stack.
